title: UKPNP International Kashmir Conference, House of Commons, London – July 8, 2025
excerpt: A landmark UKPNP International Kashmir Conference was held in the Houses of Parliament, London, addressing peace, security, human rights, and the reunification of the forcibly divided State of Jammu and Kashmir.
author: Sardar Nasir Aziz Khan

heroImage.caption: UKPNP International Kashmir Conference, Boothroyd Room, House of Commons, London

body.text: UKPNP International Conference on Jammu & Kashmir – House of Commons, London

The United Kashmir People’s National Party (UKPNP) convened a major international conference in the Boothroyd Room of the Houses of Parliament, London, focusing on peace, security, and fundamental rights in Jammu and Kashmir.
“Kashmir is not a territorial or bilateral issue. It is an international issue.” – Sardar Shaukat Ali Kashmiri
The conference was hosted by Richard Burgon MP, Labour MP for Leeds East and former Shadow Secretary of State for Justice.
UKPNP has consistently opposed violence, terrorism, extremism, and the weaponization of faith.

body.caption: Panel session during the UKPNP International Kashmir Conference

body.text: Distinguished Parliamentarians and Speakers
The conference featured participation from Fabian Hamilton MP, Imran Hussain MP, Ian Byrne MP, and senior UKPNP leadership.
“Self-determination is a fundamental right which Kashmiris deserve.” – Ian Byrne MP
Condemnation of Pahalgam Terror Attack and Extrajudicial Killings

body.caption: Zarnosh Nasim, victim of extrajudicial killing in Rawalakot

body.text: Speakers condemned the Pahalgam terror attack and the extrajudicial killings of Zarnosh Nasim and Jibran Nasim.
UKPNP demands an immediate end to extrajudicial killings, torture, enforced disappearances, and misuse of anti-terror laws.
Demand for Release of Political Prisoners

body.caption: Delegates discussing human rights and regional security

body.text: The conference demanded the release of political prisoners across all regions of Jammu and Kashmir.
“We demand freedom of expression, movement, reunification, and the right to self-determination for all.” – Sardar Shaukat Ali Kashmiri
Participants and Delegates

body.caption: Participants of the UKPNP International Kashmir Conference
Delegates and community leaders attending the conference
Panelists discussing regional peace and security
Audience during the UKPNP conference session

body.text: Democratic Governance and Political Participation
Speakers stressed the need for democratic freedoms across all regions of Jammu and Kashmir.
“No part of Jammu and Kashmir should be used to conduct proxy wars or spread ideological radicalization.”
International Engagement and Working Group
The conference called for international engagement and proposed the creation of an International Kashmir Peace and Human Rights Working Group.
“A lasting and just peace can only be achieved through justice, accountability, and inclusive dialogue.”
Concluding Remarks
UKPNP leadership thanked MP Richard Burgon and all participating MPs for their support.
